note: Two Top-tab captures were run. The bare query `pomodoro technique` (f=top) returned mostly generic productivity listicle threads that mention Pomodoro as item 3 of 14; this refined query (quality filters: no link-spam, min 20 likes, focus/study context) returned substantially more on-topic takes and is the kept set. The bare-query capture is preserved below under `broadQueryResults` for provenance. f=live was not used: for a keyword this saturated with app-promo bots, Latest is worse than Top, and the refined Top query already solved the relevance problem.

broadQueryResults.author: Ankur Warikoo
broadQueryResults.text:
2. Pomodoro Technique

A time management technique that's proven to maximize productivity and attention.

Break your day into 25min chunks followed by a 5min break (this 30min unit is called Pomodoro).
After about 4 pomodoros, take a longer break of 15-20mins.
